from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib
b=Path('.local/tool-tasks/plan-witness-propagation-20261006')
paths=[Path(x) for x in ['src/Search/CombatSearchCoordinator.PlanSearch.cs','src/Search/CombatBeamSolver.Retention.cs','src/Search/StrategicHpRecoveryBound.Components.cs']]
pure={str(p):p.read_bytes() for p in paths}
(b/'pure-before-diagnostic.json').write_text(json.dumps({p:v.decode() for p,v in pure.items()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
try:
 subprocess.run(['python3',str(b/'install-diagnostics.py')],check=True)
 (b/'diagnostic-sources.json').write_text(json.dumps({str(p):p.read_text() for p in paths},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
 cmd=['dotnet','build','CombatSolver.csproj','-c','Release','-p:CopyModOnBuild=false','-o',str((b/'build-diagnostic').resolve())]
 (b/'diagnostic-build-command.json').write_text(json.dumps(cmd,indent=2)+'\n')
 with (b/'build-diagnostic.log').open('w') as log:subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=60)
finally:
 for p,v in pure.items():Path(p).write_bytes(v)
 assert all(Path(p).read_bytes()==v for p,v in pure.items())
print('Diagnostic-only artifact built; three main sources restored exactly.')

from pathlib import Path
import collections, hashlib, json, re, statistics

base = Path.cwd()
task = base / '.local/tool-tasks/plan-witness-propagation-20261006'
report = base / 'docs/performance/plan-witness-propagation-20261006.json'
def read(name): return json.loads((task / name).read_text())
def sha(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

final = read('single-screen-summary.json') + read('single-regression-summary.json')
plan_only = read('plan-screen-summary.json') + read('plan-regression-summary.json')
assert len(final) == 44 and all(r['status'] == 'Completed' for r in final)
summaries = []
for scene in dict.fromkeys(r['scene'] for r in final):
    rows = [r for r in final if r['scene'] == scene]
    assert [r['label'] for r in rows] == ['A1', 'C1', 'C2', 'A2']
    invariants = {k: all(r[k] == rows[0][k] for r in rows)
                  for k in ['rootStampSha256', 'budget', 'policy', 'comparisonQuality']}
    assert all(invariants.values())
    a = [r for r in rows if r['label'].startswith('A')]
    c = [r for r in rows if r['label'].startswith('C')]
    av = statistics.mean(r['wallSeconds'] for r in a)
    cv = statistics.mean(r['wallSeconds'] for r in c)
    pa = max(r['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for r in a)
    pc = max(r['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for r in c)
    assert pc <= pa * 1.1
    summaries.append(dict(scene=scene, controlMeanSeconds=av, candidateMeanSeconds=cv,
                          speedup=av/cv, controlPeakBytes=pa, candidatePeakBytes=pc,
                          peakChangePercent=(pc/pa-1)*100, invariants=invariants,
                          comparisonQuality=rows[0]['comparisonQuality']))

diagnostics = read('diagnostic-summary.json')
audits = read('root-audit-summary.json')
assert len(diagnostics) == 2 and len(audits) == 9
certifications = []
for row in diagnostics + audits:
    comparison = next(r for r in final if r['scene'] == row['scene'] and r['label'] == 'C1')
    assert row['rootStampSha256'] == comparison['rootStampSha256']
    log = next(s for s in row['latePlanDiagnostics'] if 'ROOT_COMPONENT_PROOF ' in s)
    match = re.search(r'reason=(.*?) elapsed_ms=([0-9.]+)', log)
    cert = dict(scene=row['scene'], reason=match[1],
                rootAssessmentMilliseconds=float(match[2]), sameFrozenRoot=True,
                mode=row['budget']['searchMode'], sampleIsPerformanceAcceptance=False)
    if row in diagnostics:
        keys = ['budget', 'policy', 'comparisonQuality', 'rootStampSha256']
        cert['sameFullRequestInvariants'] = all(row[k] == comparison[k] for k in keys)
        cert['sameWork'] = all(row['solverMetrics'][k] == comparison['solverMetrics'][k]
                               for k in ['totalExpanded', 'totalTransitions', 'totalChoiceBranches'])
        assert cert['sameFullRequestInvariants'] and cert['sameWork']
    certifications.append(cert)
assert len(certifications) == 11

requests = Path('/home/ltlly/Code/nmslmod/CombatSolver-perf-20261001/.local/veryhigh-dop16/frozen-corpus/requests')
input_archives = {}
for scene in (r['scene'] for r in summaries):
    path = requests / (scene + '.json')
    value = json.loads(path.read_text())
    entry = dict(requestSource=path.read_text(), requestSha256=sha(path.read_bytes()))
    if value.get('generatedScenarioPath'):
        gp = Path(value['generatedScenarioPath'])
        entry.update(generatedScenarioSource=gp.read_text(), generatedScenarioSha256=sha(gp.read_bytes()))
    input_archives[scene] = entry

old = json.loads((base / 'docs/performance/late-plan-gc-retention-research-20261006.json').read_text())
# Keep the earlier quality counterexample in this self-contained phase report.
def find_runs(value):
    if isinstance(value, list):
        for item in value:
            if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get('scene') == 'dev-06-silent-boss' and 'comparisonQuality' in item:
                yield item
            else: yield from find_runs(item)
    elif isinstance(value, dict):
        for item in value.values(): yield from find_runs(item)
historical = list(find_runs(old.get('runs', [])))
assert historical and any(r['comparisonQuality']['projectedBattleHpLost'] == 54 for r in historical)

source_paths = [
    'src/Runtime/SearchGcPolicy.cs', 'src/Search/CombatSearchCoordinator.PlanSearch.cs',
    'src/Testing/Contracts/Search/UnattendedTestRunner.ComponentSmartBound.cs',
    'src/Testing/Contracts/Search/UnattendedTestRunner.PlanMemberIncumbent.cs',
    'tools/testing/checks/CombatSolver.GcPolicyChecks/GcCheckpointChecks.cs',
    'tools/testing/checks/CombatSolver.GcPolicyChecks/GcPortableRuntimeChecks.cs',
]
native_names = ['native-plan', 'native-plan-debug', 'native-plan-final', 'native-plan-proof', 'native-single-gc']
native = {name: read(name + '/result.json') for name in native_names}
search_sources = read('plan-only-sources.json')
assert all((base / p).read_text() == value for p, value in search_sources.items())
scripts = {p.name: dict(source=p.read_text(), sha256=sha(p.read_bytes())) for p in task.glob('*.py')}
evidence_names = [p.name for p in task.glob('*command.json')] + [
    'single-portable.log', 'single-confirmed-checkpoint.log', 'build-single-confirmed.log',
    'build-diagnostic.log', 'interruption.json', 'root-audit-invalid-summary.json',
    'root-audit-invalid-nodes-summary.json', 'diagnostic-build-command.json',
]
evidence = {name: dict(source=(task/name).read_text(), sha256=sha((task/name).read_bytes()))
            for name in dict.fromkeys(evidence_names)}
document = dict(
    schemaVersion=1, date='2026-10-06', upstream='9a4489d840a3772aef451d5c6dc42dd79719f380',
    sourceHeadBeforePhase='ff93cd81', baselineRuntimeSource='bb004176',
    decision='Adopt the verified single-compaction combination as a partial result; all-original-root goal remains active.',
    baselineDllSha256=final[0]['plan']['dllSha256'],
    candidateDllSha256=next(r['plan']['dllSha256'] for r in final if r['label']=='C1'),
    game=dict(version='0.111.0 / 41cef1ea',
              dllSha256='2b40d2df538db1ceb5fa48d958c80ab730ada1e07db88a870aff01a661768b9f',
              mvid='8a76776c-0ce1-4d4f-90bd-8cce653dad8e'),
    environment=dict(runtime='Microsoft.NETCore.App 9.0.19', workstationGC=True,
                     platform='Linux x86_64', profilerOrCorrectnessInstrumentation=False),
    protocol=dict(order='A1/C1/C2/A2, serial separate processes', requestCount=44, roots=11,
                  elapsed='Complete Coordinator wallSeconds; arithmetic mean of two runs per side',
                  rss='Maximum process peak across both runs per side, including warmup and all request phases',
                  cliBudgetMilliseconds=300000, capturedProfileSoftBudgetMilliseconds=600000,
                  productionBudget=True, fixedSearchBudget=False, outerTimeoutSeconds=120,
                  beam=135, nodes=500000, cardPileHandBranches=[72,42,54], dop=16,
                  noGcRegionBudgetGigabytes=16,
                  budgetNote='The harness budget field describes the CLI override. With production budget, the captured policy profile retains 600000 ms and the existing member limits. Both sides have identical complete budget/policy; no budget was raised.'),
    summaries=summaries, finalRuns=final, inputArchives=input_archives, rejectedPlanOnlyRuns=plan_only,
    rejectedPlanOnlySource=search_sources, rejectedPlanOnlyPatch=(task/'plan-only.patch').read_text(),
    historicalSilentBossCounterexample=historical,
    historicalCounterexampleMeaning='Earlier double-GC variant had candidate HP loss 57 vs control 54; this current cohort is 57 on all four runs. Preserve variability and do not claim recovery of every historical best route.',
    native=native, sourceReuse=dict(searchProofRun=native['native-plan-proof']['runId'],
                                    searchProofDllSha256=native['native-plan-proof']['mainAssemblyHash'],
                                    threeSearchSourcesExactlyEqual=True,
                                    reason='Only Runtime collection code changed after the native search proof. Exact search sources, DLL dependencies, frozen game version, guards and branch semantics are reused; GC has its own final native proof.'),
    certification=dict(newSourceCertificates=0, auditedRoots=11,
                       strictComponentCertified=sum(x['reason']=='certified' for x in certifications),
                       assessments=certifications, unknownRootAction='Refuse this new plan witness gate; keep existing search',
                       deferredPlanRoots=3, deferredPlanRootsWithUsableStrictWitness=1,
                       scope='Root eligibility statistics, not full universe certification. Other existing bound policies remain unchanged.'),
    diagnosticRuns=diagnostics, rootAuditRuns=audits,
    diagnosticMeaning=dict(actualLatePlanPrunes=465, legacyTighteningPrunes=0,
                           queryCallsUntilLateLog=55225, unknownQueriesUntilLateLog=0,
                           summedQueryElapsedMilliseconds=402.2572, rootAssessmentMilliseconds=7.8086,
                           note='Repeated queries from all members up to the log, summed worker stopwatch durations; not unique states, CPU time, late-member-only cost or acceptance elapsed.'),
    candidateSources={p:dict(source=(base/p).read_text(), sha256=sha((base/p).read_bytes())) for p in source_paths},
    diagnosticSources=read('diagnostic-sources.json'), temporaryScripts=scripts, evidence=evidence,
    portableEvidencePremise='Six cases passed on the first single-compaction build; the two later completion guards affect only the supported detailed-info path, unreachable in this injected unsupported-info suite. Final detailed-info completion is covered by the final native lifecycle and checkpoint fixture.',
    finalValidation=dict(tools='TOOLS_OK files=294 projects=37 errors=0',
                         coverage='COVERAGE_OK data=529 fixtures=479 groups=37 errors=0',
                         firstBoundaryAttempt='Failed: old literal assumed the former one-argument call. Both platform gates updated to require the collector and restart-only compaction argument.'),
    unverified=[
        'All 29 original roots, uploaded player packages, full visible Steam/Windows/Android performance.',
        'New DOP1/16 whole Coordinator equivalence; current native proof covers actual member dispatch and loops.',
        'Recovery of the historical Silent boss HP54 result and original Necrobinder boss HP0 route.',
        'Full closure certification for the nine rejected roots; no new unknown source is declared safe.',
    ],
)
report.write_text(json.dumps(document,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Saved phase evidence:',len(final),'final pure,',len(plan_only),'rejected pure/interrupted,',len(diagnostics),'diagnostic,',len(audits),'root audits; bytes',report.stat().st_size)
for row in summaries:
    q=row['comparisonQuality']
    print(f"| {row['scene']} | {row['controlMeanSeconds']:.3f} → {row['candidateMeanSeconds']:.3f} | {row['speedup']:.3f} | {row['peakChangePercent']:+.3f}% | {q['projectedBattleHpLost']} | {q['projectedBattlePotionCount']}/{q['potionStrategicCost']} | {q['combatEndedTurn']} |")
